edits.text:
-- HEALTH_EXPENSE_FAMILY_ENTRY: actual component discovery, no authority inferred.
  perform private.timesheet_contract_expense_family_enter_v1(
    w.environment,w.id,null,null) from public.candidate_expense_components e
    join public.candidate_submission_workflows w on w.id=e.workflow_id
    where e.expense_component_id=p_expense_component_id;

-- HEALTH_EXPENSE_FAMILY_ENTRY: genuine existing manager token ownership.
  if not exists(select 1 from public.candidate_pending_expense_updates u
    join public.candidate_approval_requests a on a.id=u.approval_request_id and a.workflow_id=u.workflow_id
    join public.candidate_submission_workflows w on w.id=u.workflow_id
    where w.id=p_workflow_id and w.environment=private._candidate_assert_environment(p_environment)
      and u.state in('EDITING','RENDERING') and a.state='PENDING'
      and a.token_hash=decode(lower(p_approval_token_hash_hex),'hex')) then return null;end if;
  -- HEALTH_EXPENSE_FAMILY_ENTRY: locks only, before native mutable row locks.
  perform private.timesheet_contract_expense_family_enter_v1(
    p_environment,p_workflow_id,null,null);

edits.remove:
for v_target in
    select update_row.update_id,update_row.workflow_id
    from public.candidate_pending_expense_updates update_row
    join public.candidate_submission_workflows workflow
      on workflow.id=update_row.workflow_id
    where workflow.environment=v_environment
      and update_row.state in ('EDITING','RENDERING')
      and update_row.expires_at_utc<=p_now_utc
    order by update_row.expires_at_utc,update_row.update_id
    limit p_limit
edits.text:
-- HEALTH_EXPENSE_FAMILY_ENTRY: same original bounded selection, immutable local list.
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(selected) order by selected.ordinal),'[]'::jsonb) into v_family_targets
  from (
    select update_row.update_id,update_row.workflow_id,
      row_number() over(order by update_row.expires_at_utc,update_row.update_id) ordinal
    from public.candidate_pending_expense_updates update_row
    join public.candidate_submission_workflows workflow
      on workflow.id=update_row.workflow_id
    where workflow.environment=v_environment
      and update_row.state in ('EDITING','RENDERING')
      and update_row.expires_at_utc<=p_now_utc
    order by update_row.expires_at_utc,update_row.update_id
    limit p_limit
  ) selected;
  perform private.timesheet_contract_expense_families_enter_v1(v_environment,
    array(select (item->>'workflow_id')::uuid from jsonb_array_elements(v_family_targets) item),null,null);
  for v_target in
    select (item->>'update_id')::uuid update_id,(item->>'workflow_id')::uuid workflow_id
    from jsonb_array_elements(v_family_targets) with ordinality rows(item,ordinal) order by ordinal
